title: Tech Note: Communicating via a serial port with 4D

historical_commentary.text: Serial port communication was a common hardware integration method in the late 1990s but has been almost entirely replaced by USB, Bluetooth, and network-based protocols. 4D's SET CHANNEL command for serial I/O was eventually deprecated. Modern 4D developers would use system workers, plugins, or external process calls for hardware communication.
related_updates: Serial port commands like SET CHANNEL have been deprecated in modern 4D
Hardware communication now typically uses USB or network protocols via system workers or plugins
